MUSIC AND DANCE — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   C. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   D. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software..

   D. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..

   D. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.

10. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey

12. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)

15. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
